description: This file defines the AttributeSyncRuleService class, which manages attribute synchronization rules, including evaluating conditions based on user attributes and team memberships.

classes.name: AttributeSyncRuleService
classes.description: Service class for managing attribute synchronization rules, including condition evaluation based on user attributes and team memberships.

methods.name: shouldSyncApplyToUser
methods.description: Determines if attribute sync should be applied to a user based on rule conditions.

methods.name: handleTeamConditions
methods.description: Evaluates team-related conditions for a user.

methods.name: handleAttributeConditions
methods.description: Evaluates attribute-related conditions for a user.

methods.name: evaluateAttributeCondition
methods.description: Evaluates a single attribute condition against a user's attribute.

methods.name: evaluateSingleValueCondition
methods.description: Evaluates single-value attribute conditions such as text, number, or single select.
